description: Read the access object of a task list (list_id) or a task (task_id): access_level (open, assigned or secured; a task-level value wins over its list), the effective level, human assignees and agent_assignee (the one agent whose key may reach the list and every task on it; a task shows its list's, inherited), and the floor (a Decisions list or a passkey card never goes below assigned). Read tier.
name: tascan_get_access
